reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis misinterprets the research question by proposing a processing route to increase hardness/strength rather than explaining the mechanisms governing the low hardness/strength of the starting simple solid-solution state, and the predicted outcome contradicts the stated favorable plasticity.
reasons.testability: The proposed test measures hardness and phase fractions of the new material against a cast baseline, but it does not test the mechanistic explanation for the low strength of the original equimolar solid solution, so it fails to address the question.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic because it describes how to make a different, stronger material instead of explaining the deformation behavior and low strength of the simple solid-solution CoCrFeNiTi, offering no insight into the asked question.
